## Overview

No single weather forecast is best everywhere. At ClimateAi, I built a meta-model that combines several public and private forecasts, weighting each one by its recent skill at each location and lead time, to produce more accurate short-term forecasts of mean temperature and precipitation.

## My Role

-   Designed a multi-model ensemble algorithm combining **6 data sources**, with separate weights for **30 customer locations** and **4 lead times**
-   Improved short-term forecasts by **20%** over the best vendor's model
-   Built automated Google Cloud pipelines for geospatial data extraction, preprocessing, and forecast skill & uncertainty analysis, updating the model weights weekly
-   Presented Tableau map visualizations comparing our model's performance with competitors'

## Tools

Python · Xarray · pandas · Google Cloud · Tableau
